blocks.text: Points to a screenshot. Not proof.

callouts: A status bar is a screen element, but it is easy to crop out.
A phone-screen shape is a hint; sizes overlap and resizing changes them.
No camera make, model or exposure; also normal for any shared image.
A photo of a screen usually shows wavy patterns, glare or tilt.
Then check the claim itself: where did this image come from?
